stories.title: Fugitive wanted in 2004 attempted murder case arrested in Mexico after over 20 years
stories.summary: A 53-year-old man wanted in a 2004 Sacramento attempted murder case was arrested in Mexico after more than 20 years as a fugitive.

stories.title: 22-year-old Ceres man killed, four hurt in rollover crash
stories.summary: A 22-year-old Ceres man died early Thursday in a rollover crash on Blaker Road north of Grayson Road, according to the California Highway Patrol.

stories.title: Sacramento Weather Forecast
stories.summary: Areas of dense morning fog Friday with partial afternoon clearing. Tracking a return to rain and snow by the end of the weekend.

stories.title: Vacaville shooting leaves person wounded after reported altercation
stories.summary: Vacaville police are investigating a shooting that happened early Thursday morning near East Main Street and Davis Street in downtown Vacaville.

stories.title: Land Park turkey, known for blocking traffic, hit by car
stories.summary: The turkey known for hanging around Taylor's Market in Land Park was hit by a car Tuesday night. Front Street Animal Shelter transported him for medical treatment.

stories.title: Stockton family holds vigil for 6-year-old girl killed in shooting; man arrested
stories.summary: Candles, prayers and memories brought the community together to honor Jennily, whose family is now pleading for the violence to stop.

stories.title: 20-year-old arrested in fatal shooting of 6-year-old girl in Stockton
stories.summary: Stockton police arrested a 20-year-old man in connection with a shooting that killed 6-year-old Jennily Srang and injured an 11-year-old boy on Flint Avenue.

stories.title: Prop. 5 passes: Special elections, governor appointments to replace recalled officials
stories.summary: The measure eliminates the two-question recall ballot and establishes separate elections to choose replacements for recalled officials.

stories.title: Stockton mass shooting case heads to prosecutors ahead of one-year mark
stories.summary: Prosecutors said they expect to take over the case by Thursday.

stories.title: Deadly mushrooms may surge amid El Niño rains, California health officials warn
stories.summary: These highly toxic mushrooms closely resemble safe and edible varieties in both appearance and taste.

stories.title: Family remembers Jennily Srang, 6-year-old killed in Stockton shooting
stories.summary: The Stockton Unified School District is mourning the loss of Jennily Srang, a first grader at August School who was killed in a shooting Tuesday afternoon.

stories.title: Roads to close for Sacramento’s Run to Feed the Hungry 2026 | Here's where
stories.summary: Road closures for the Thanksgiving run in East Sacramento will last until about noon, the city said. The 10K run begins at 8:15 a.m.; the 5K starts at 9 a.m.
